description: Prompt interrupt runs cleanup. Verified state: `askSecret` calls `process.exit(130)` on byte `0x03` at `.agro/cli/src/lib/prompt.ts:82`. `askSecretPiped` calls `process.exit(130)` in its `SIGINT` handler at `.agro/cli/src/lib/prompt.ts:134`. `process.exit` skips every pending `finally` block. A temp directory or a lock file that the caller holds stays on disk.

userStories.title: Ctrl-C at a prompt rejects with a typed error
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Ctrl-C at an `agro` prompt to unwind the command so that each `finally` block releases its lock or temp directory.
acceptanceCriteria: `askSecret` rejects with an exported `PromptInterruptedError` when the TTY input contains byte `0x03`.
`askSecretPiped` rejects with `PromptInterruptedError` when the process receives `SIGINT`, and the function removes its `SIGINT` listener.
A new test proves that a `finally` block around `askSecret` runs after byte `0x03`. The test failed before the fix.
`runCli` in `.agro/cli/src/cli.ts` returns exit code `130` for `PromptInterruptedError` and writes no stack trace.
`pnpm test` exits 0 from the harness root.
`pnpm typecheck` exits 0 from the harness root.

userStories.title: Manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript so that I can confirm the interrupt behavior without a rerun.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/prompt-interrupt-runs-cleanup/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the commands and exit codes of `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck`.
The transcript holds the output of the new interrupt test from US-001.
